block.guhs.glas_restje: Glass with a little bit left
item.guhs.glas_restje: Glass with a little bit left
block.guhs.glas_restje.lore: Don't throw it away, it's not empty yet! (Rommelguh)
block.guhs.glas_restje.lore2: Click with another glass: one more. Empty hand: a sip.
gui.guhs.glas_restje.slokje2: You take a sip. A little bit stays behind, of course.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.gespawnd: %s is right in front of you, njeg!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.0: ...njeg. I'm just a little tired. For a long time now.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.1: Everyone has a little place to sleep. Not me.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.2: My ear? It's been bent since... always, really.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes.grap.3: When I close my eyes, it's so quiet. Too quiet.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.0: I slept! Really slept! Njeg njeg!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.1: That box is the coziest spot in the whole world.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.2: Welcome to Guhdreamland! Sweet dreams already!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.snoes_blij.grap.3: The cat house is very pretty too, though. For daytime.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.zandguh.grap.0: A pinch of dream sand and poof: the nicest dreams. Don't rub your eyes!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.zandguh.grap.1: I've been sprinkling for four hundred years. My sack has never been empty. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.zandguh.grap.2: Are you yawning? Good. Then it works.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.wekkerguh.grap.1: Five more minutes? Everyone says that. Always.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.wekkerguh.grap.2: Want to wake up? Then I'll ring you gently back to your bed.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.wekkerguh.grap.3: I've hit snooze 3 times today already. Breaking records, njeg.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.0: Don't throw it away! It's not empty yet!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.1: I collect glasses. With a little bit left. It's a hobby.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.2: Tidy up? Tomorrow. Or the day after. Or in a dream.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.rommelguh.grap.3: This one's from Tuesday. Or last Tuesday. Cheers!
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.0: I'm knitting a scarf. Who for? You'll see, dear.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.1: Another cookie, dear? There are plenty.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.2: At the family day there were so many of us. And still I missed one...
gui.guhs.droomwezens.droom_omaguh.grap.3: Stitch, stitch, drop... oh well, a little hole is cozy.
gui.guhs.droomwezens.kussengevecht_guh.g: PILLOW FIGHT! Not on the snout, that's the rule.
Watch out, this one's extra fluffy! FLUMP!
I've never lost. I've never won either. Njeg.
Feathers everywhere. That's how you know it was a good fight.
